messages:
Maria Chen: morning — async standup: yesterday I finished ingesting prompt_set_v3 and ran smoke evals on llama-13b-q. Found ~0.7 point drop on accuracy for retrieval QA. Blocker: need ~200 labeled examples for the new prompts. Today: triage regressions + prep canary if we can stabilize.

Ajay Patel: saw that too. My quick debug points to a tokenization edge for certain special chars in prompts. Ran: `python eval.py --model llama-13b-q --prompts prompts_v3.json` — truncation at `#` in some cases. Pushed a small fix to token_util and opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-platform/pull/7845 

Lee Wong: re-ran Ajay's patched evals on a 1k subset — hallucination rate up ~4% (entities invented). rouge-L down ~0.6. Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1935/llama13b-q/fix1. Planning A/B: baseline vs token-fix.

Samir Khan: can we try a tiny prompt template tweak too? adding an explicit "source:" anchor reduced hallucination in prior experiments. I sketched a patch in a gist, will paste if useful. Also we should warm the KV cache during canary rollout.

Rachel Gomez: pinged infra for a conservative canary: 5% traffic, eu-west-1 only, 1h ramp, fallback to llama-7b-quant on errors. I can add rollout config once we have PRs merged. Need approval from eng-platform on infra PR.

Maria Chen: I added a labeler request in #support for the 200 samples (tagged data-ops). Also need reviews: @Ajay's token_util PR and the infra canary PR. Can folks review today?

Lee Wong: reviewing Ajay's PR now. Small nit: add a unit test for tokenization edge cases (multi-byte chars + comment tokens). If added, I'll approve.

Ajay Patel: just pushed the test. Also noticed KV cache warmup affects early-step perplexity; logs attached in the PR. Samir — can you add a warmup job to rollout tasks?

Samir Khan: will add warmup. Quick warmup snippet I plan to include in the rollout:
```bash
# warmup requests to populate KV cache
for i in {1..10}; do
  curl -s -X POST \"https://stage.redwood/api/generate\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"warmup prompt"}' &>/dev/null
done
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployment will be scheduled once required PRs are merged and the canary config is approved. Current status: no active canary.

Rachel Gomez: created the infra canary PR and added the warmup job; linked reviewers = @eng-platform, @eng-runtime. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 (contains traffic split + fallback policy).

Maria Chen: thanks — unresolved blockers: labelers and the perf regression for long contexts. If token fix doesn't land by EOD we'll rollback prompt_set_v3 for the canary and run the A/B with the previous set.

Ajay Patel: will push follow-up perf tests by noon PST and update PR. ping me if you need more logs.

Lee Wong: thumbs up — I'll re-run the full 5k eval after Ajay's tests finish. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: great, keep updates here. If anyone hits a hard blocker call me or DM.
